name: What is AI website optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI website optimization uses artificial intelligence and machine learning to analyze user behavior, website performance, and market trends. It identifies areas for improvement to enhance user experience, increase conversion rates, and improve search engine rankings. This technology automates data analysis and suggests or implements changes to elements like content, design, and technical SEO, making the optimization process more efficient and data-driven than traditional methods.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI website optimization uses artificial intelligence to analyze website data and suggest or implement improvements for better user experience and performance.
